mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_line ( approval_seq, approval_status, approval_id, approver_id, approver_name, approver_rank ) VALUES ( #{approvalSeq}, #{approvalStatus}, #{approvalId}, #{approverId}, #{approverName}, #{approverRank} )
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_line SET approval_status = 'PENDING' WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} AND approval_status = 'TEMP'
mapper.select: SELECT approver_id FROM approval_line WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} ORDER BY approval_seq ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT approval_line_id AS approvalLineId, approval_seq AS approvalSeq, approver_id AS approverId FROM approval_line WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} AND approval_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY approval_seq ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_line SET approval_status = 'COMPLETE', reason = #{reason}, approved_dt = NOW() WHERE approval_line_id = #{approvalLineId}
UPDATE approval_line SET approval_status = 'REJECTED', reason = #{reason}, approved_dt = NOW() WHERE approval_line_id = #{approvalLineId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_line WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} AND approval_status = 'PENDING'
SELECT approver_id FROM approval_line WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} AND approval_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY approval_seq ASC
